headline: EU, Germany, Netherlands, and Greece Join US-Led 'Pax Silica' Initiative for AI Supply Chain Security
summary: This signals a significant geopolitical realignment, potentially ending Europe's pursuit of digital sovereignty by formally aligning with the US on securing AI infrastructure, semiconductors, and critical mineral supply chains. The move will reshape global tech alliances and accelerate efforts to de-risk supply chains from adversaries, particularly impacting China.
